appDesc.message: Fills job application forms in any language from your local profile. Optional AI for custom questions via MCP.

profileEmptyHint.message: Your profile is empty. Fill in the 👤 Profile tab so autofill can work.

btnCopyPromptTip.message: Copy a compact prompt for Claude Code / AGY CLI

btnSaveRepoTip.message: Save the job posting to your resume repository (needs the bridge)

btnLearnSub.message: Standard fields → profile, other questions → answers

btnLearnTip.message: Save what you typed into this form so the next forms fill themselves

profileHint.message: Stored only locally in your browser. Filled into forms with zero tokens.

translationsTitle.message: Translations for forms in other languages

translationsHint.message: Used when a form is in that language (e.g. a city name in Ukrainian). Country names and Yes/No are translated automatically; empty = use the main value.

learnedHint.message: Questions you have already answered. Filled automatically with 0 tokens.

learnedEmpty.message: No saved answers yet. Fill a form and press "Remember from this form".

serverHint.message: Connects the extension to Claude Code, AGY and the MCP server.

serverRepoHint.message: Optional: RESUME_REPO_PATH=/path/to/repo npm run bridge loads role variants and PDF resumes from a repository.

howToTitle.message: How to connect Claude Code / AGY:

howTo1.message: Start the bridge: npm run bridge in the project folder (port 8765)

howTo3.message: The assistant can then call get_active_job_form and fill_job_form itself.

allSitesLabel.message: Work on any website (custom company career pages). Chrome will ask for permission.

footer.message: 🔒 The final submit button is never clicked automatically.

resumeTooBig.message: The resume file is larger than 5 MB.

bridgeOfflineHint.message: The bridge is offline. Run 'npm run bridge' in a terminal.

systemPage.message: The extension works on job pages (Ashby, Greenhouse, Lever...). Chrome blocks access to browser system pages.
